items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Professor Minetta has mentioned Mary Mack... Professor Minetta has told us all about those too... I think Professor Minetta said he opened another place

ctx.x: Louisiana. That's West New Orleans. On July the 28th, 1891. That makes me 68 this birthday.

Yes. 28th of July. Before I forget it, I don't think I'll forget it, but Professor Minetta has mentioned Mary Mack. I didn't know if you were known by that name. Mary Mack, yes. At that time. He mentioned that Mary Mack came from Algiers and was a wonderful singer and entertainer. I know he would send his regards. He didn't know I was going to see you. Well, I'd be glad. And I see him almost every Tuesday night. I go over to his studio where he teaches and I record a little interview with him. I see. And when he…
hearing your voice again. Well, I would be glad for you to play, for him to hear. Me and Mac. Yes, and we had, we were known in show business as Mary Mack's Merry Makers. Oh, yes.
